title: The Grave Robbers
logline: An archivist hires a pilot to track down and destroy a smuggler barge that has been illegally harvesting cybernetics from an ancient cemetery.

roles.description: Fiercely protective, deeply respectful of the dead.
Sleazy, wearing too much cheap jewelry.
A vast field of frozen sarcophagi drifting in the dark zone.
A rusted hauler equipped with heavy grappling claws.
The organization tasked with protecting historical sites.

public_situation: The {role:antiquities_guild} has declared the {role:ancient_cemetery} a protected heritage site, forbidding all salvage operations.
private_truth: The corrupt broker is paying smugglers to rip high-grade military cybernetics out of the corpses to sell on the black market.

beats.public_change: Several sarcophagi are discovered ripped open and stripped of tech.

missions.reason: The archivist hires the pilot to scan the dark zone around the cemetery to track the smugglers' ion trails.
missions.private_fact: The trail leads directly to a known black-market staging ground.

missions.reason: The archivist asks the pilot to collect a partially harvested cybernetic arm from the wreckage for evidence.
missions.private_fact: The arm contains a tracking chip pointing to the broker.

beats.public_change: The broker attempts to flood the market with the stolen cybernetics.

missions.reason: The broker hires the pilot to buy specialized plasma cutters and deliver them to the smuggler barge.
missions.private_fact: The cutters are specifically designed to crack open heavy military-grade coffins.

beats.public_change: The archivist secures the coordinates of the smuggler barge.

missions.reason: The archivist pays the pilot to attack the barge and recover the stolen cybernetics from its cargo hold.
missions.private_fact: The barge is heavily armored and calls in mercenary reinforcements.

beats.public_change: The smuggler barge attempts to flee the system with the remaining bodies.

missions.reason: The archivist begs the pilot to completely destroy the barge so the dead can rest.
missions.private_fact: The broker hails the pilot, offering them a massive cut of the profits if they let the barge jump away.

resolutions.summary: The barge is destroyed. The dead are left in peace, and the broker is arrested by the guild for desecration.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot destroyed a smuggler ship to protect an ancient space cemetery.

resolutions.summary: The barge escapes. The cemetery is completely stripped bare. The archivist resigns in despair, and the pilot gets rich off grave robbery.
The barge easily outruns the authorities and escapes. The graveyard is desecrated, and the broker vanishes with the profits.

loose_threads.detail: The bodies in the cemetery were all soldiers from a secret war the government claims never happened.
The broker boasts that half the guild's leadership was getting a cut of the grave-robbing profits.

radio_hooks: {role:antiquities_guild} promises swift justice for grave robbers.

voice_direction.desperate_archivist: Fierce, protective, speaks with absolute moral certainty.
voice_direction.corrupt_broker: Greasy, overly familiar, speaks too loudly.
